title: Amount Owed on the Installment a TRICARE Prime One-Time Payment Settles
content:
The installment a one-time payment settles on a fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment is owed according to its own frequency:

- a **monthly** installment is owed at one twelfth of the annual fee of the enrollment's fee arrangement (divided by 12), rounded to the cent;
- a **quarterly** installment at one quarter of that fee (divided by 4), rounded to the cent;
- **otherwise** at the whole annual fee.

The annual fee is the tier's annual individual fee for an individual arrangement and its annual family fee for a family arrangement.

## Hypothetical figures

| Arrangement | Settled installment | Owed |
|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Prime Retiree Group B, family (969.36) | monthly | 80.78 |
| TRICARE Prime Retiree Group B, family (969.36) | quarterly | 242.34 |
| TRICARE Prime Retiree Group A, individual (390.12) | annual | 390.12 |

A monthly installment of the Group B family arrangement with 40.00 standing against it leaves 40.78 against the 80.78 owed.
